title: 3v3 Half-Court Game to Seven
description: Live 3v3 in the half court with simple rules that reward passing, spacing and quick decisions, and winners who stay on offense.

content.objective: Read the defense, use the space and make quick, correct decisions in a fast 3v3 game whose rules reward good basketball.
content.setup: Two teams of three play at one basket. One team starts on offense at the top of the key with the ball; the other defends. Extra teams wait on the baseline.
content.organization: Winners stay on offense and the losing team steps out; the next team on the baseline defends. With two baskets, run two games and rotate teams between them.
instructions: Play live 3v3 to seven points. Each basket is worth one point, and a team that scores keeps the ball.
Passing rule: the offense must complete at least three passes before a shot. A shot earlier than that does not count, but play continues.
Stops rule: a steal or a defensive rebound earns the defenders a point and the ball.
After each game the coach freezes one moment, asks 'what did the defense give you?' and lets the players answer before the next game.
Rotate teams every game so everyone plays offense and defense.
coachingPoints: Move without the ball; every player is a threat.
Keep spaced: never two offensive players on the same side and the same level.
Look for the open teammate before you force a shot.
Talk on defense: call screens and switches early.
commonMistakes: All three offensive players standing still and watching the ball.
Defenders watching the ball and losing their player.
Forcing a shot while a teammate is open.
content.safety: Mark a clear boundary and keep other groups' balls away from the playing area.
progressions: Add a rule that every player must touch the ball before a shot, or allow only two dribbles per possession.
regressions: Play a few possessions of 3v2 so the offense finds the advantage before playing even numbers.
variations: Award a bonus point for a basket scored off a screen.
